name: DexaCube 3D for Elementor
author: dexaweb

sections.description:
DexaCube 3D for Elementor replaces static sliders with an interactive 3D cube showcase for products and services, offering a more engaging experience with realistic inertia rotation, full mouse and touch interaction on responsive devices, and the ability to transform each face into a slider with two clicks.

Features:
– Interactive 3D cube
– Touch and mouse support
– Responsive design
– Elementor integration
– Neon edges (basic) with presets, direction, and intensity

Third Party Libraries

This plugin bundles the following third-party libraries:

  • Splide.js
    License: MIT
    Source: https://splidejs.com/
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress.
  3. Open Elementor and add the DexaCube 3D for Elementor widget.
sections.faq:
Is there a Pro version?

Yes. An extended version with additional features is available.

What is DexaCube 3D?

DexaCube 3D is an interactive 3D showcase plugin for Elementor that transforms traditional sliders into a 3D cube experience.
Based on realistic physics with inertia, it allows visitors to rotate and interact with products in a smooth and engaging way.

Do I need Elementor Pro to use DexaCube 3D?

No. DexaCube 3D works independently and does not require Elementor Pro.
It delivers the same performance and functionality when used with both Elementor Free and Elementor Pro.

Can I use DexaCube 3D in commercial projects?

Yes. DexaCube 3D is suitable for professional and commercial projects, including client websites, landing pages, and business presentations.

Is DexaCube heavy or does it affect site performance?

No. DexaCube is built with a performance-first approach and is optimized to remain lightweight.
It follows modern web development best practices to minimize impact on loading times and Core Web Vitals.

Does DexaCube support touch interaction on mobile devices?

Yes. DexaCube is fully responsive and provides native touch interaction on mobile and tablet devices.
On desktop, interaction is handled with the mouse, while on mobile devices intuitive touch gestures allow smooth control of the cube.

How does the slider mode work?

Each face of the cube can be transformed into a slider with two clicks, allowing images to be displayed in a larger view.

Does DexaCube receive updates and bug fixes?

Yes. DexaCube follows an active versioning process with regular updates focused on bug fixes, performance improvements, and ongoing product evolution.

Can I use multiple cubes on the same page or website?

Yes. You can add multiple DexaCube instances to the same page or site.
Each cube works independently and can have its own images, settings, and visual effects.
